    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n

{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hnp
    have h1 : n ≠ 1 := by
      intro hn1
      apply hnp
      simpa [hn1] using Nat.prime_two
    obtain ⟨p, hpprime, hpdvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd h1
    have hpunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := by
